posts.title: Stingray racing and the rising bar for software
posts.description: This weekend, our five-year-old son really wanted us to make our own racing game and what he wanted was super clear: only stingrays (his favorite pet animal) racing each other, and they should say “oh my days” when they crash. Using a vibe coding tool, we pretty much zero-shot a working game. Amazing that you can just do this in 10min these days! You can see the result above.
